description.value: Crooked Lake Resort is a remote, off-grid wilderness resort in the Cariboo Mountains that has operated since the early 1960s, offering rustic cabins, RV sites, and campsites accessed via Forest Service roads from 100 Mile House or Horsefly. The resort runs on solar and generator power with limited satellite communication and explicitly lists mountain biking among its surrounding recreational activities. It appeals to self-sufficient travellers seeking solitude, with a central wash-house featuring showers and a dishwashing station serving all accommodation types.

address.value: 2225 6700 Forest Service Rd, PO Box 358, Horsefly, BC, Canada V0L 1L0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and detailed, confirming a real, operating off-grid resort in the Cariboo Mountains near Horsefly BC with blog activity as recent as September 2025. Mountain biking is explicitly listed as an activity ('explore hundreds of kilometers of trails and roads on an ATV, mountain bike, snowmobile or hike'). Power outlets are confirmed in cabins, RV sites, and the wash-house via solar/generator, supporting device charging; no bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no phone or address tags; phone (1-250-984-1307) and address (2225 6700 Forest Service Rd, PO Box 358, Horsefly, BC V0L 1L0) sourced from website only — contact_confirmed fields for phone and address are null.
Resort is accessed via unpaved Forest Service Roads; suitable only for cyclists comfortable with rough-road or bikepacking conditions.
Boil water advisory in effect for on-site gravity-fed mountain water; guests must supply their own drinking water.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly bookable resort with recent blog activity (September 2025), mountain biking listed as an on-site activity, and accommodation suitable for touring cyclists on remote Cariboo routes.
enrichment_extras.notes: Second contact number listed on website: Text or WhatsApp 250-983-2516. Email: info@crookedlakeresorthorseflybc.com. Resort states it is open year-round for lodging.

Device charging.detail: Website states 'solar and generator for lights and power outlets in the cabins, RV sites and wash-house'; power outlets available across all accommodation types
